patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: My cheek got red and swollen over a day and now it's spreading up toward my eye — it's hot and tender, and my eye's a bit puffy. It started near a spot on my face. I've got a fever now.
clinical.presentationShort: 43yo F — spreading facial cellulitis approaching the periorbital area, warm/tender, febrile; assess for orbital involvement (eye movements/vision).
clinical.presentationLong: 43-year-old female with a spreading facial cellulitis approaching the periorbital region, warm and tender with a fever — requires assessment for orbital involvement (eye movement and vision).

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → antibiotics, mark the border, CT and ophtho if any orbital signs (pain with eye movement, proptosis, vision change); monitor.
diagnosis.why: Facial cellulitis near the eye: check eye movement and vision. Preseptal is treatable; orbital cellulitis is an emergency.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, hand hovering near a red, swollen cheek
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 43-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one hand hovering near a red, swollen cheek. Expression: uncomfortable and worried. Clearly visible: a red, swollen cheek with mild puffiness near the eye. No text, no logos.
